title: Luma marketing hero: circular portal reveals alternate themes
note: Lydia: cool animation on marketing site from luma. Hero section with the headline Delightful events start here and a floating masonry grid of event cards on white. A circular clipping mask expands from the center like a portal (never fills the whole screen), and inside it the page flips to an alternate theme: Stellar (dark warp-speed streaks, white type, nightlife cards) then Vivid (fluid magenta/orange/purple mesh gradient, party cards), while the adjective in the headline swaps to match. Each cycle expands in about half a second, holds roughly two seconds, then contracts. The mask swaps the background, the cards, and specific words in the type at once, so it feels like peering through a hole into a parallel page rather than a simple color fade.
